lines.trans: Kitchen, I ask everyone to pay attention!
At first glance, these are ordinary fish trimmings.
But if you look at them more closely...
Now this is our new dish of the day.
These are exquisite homemade trout sausages.
Those trimmings used to be my own dish of the day.
Now there is no way to sneak them home from the kitchen.
Comrade Chef, taste this dish right here.
I also prepared a dish of the day out of scraps.
Well done, Fedya, let's see what is here.

meanings.note: Takes accusative. Prefix 'при-' indicates approaching, attachment, or slight degree of action (stem 'готовить'). Used as a perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to prepare, to cook, to make', paired with 'готовить'.

meanings.note: Prefix 'при-' indicates approaching, attachment, or slight degree of action (stem 'смотреться').
